dhpak1.10:2.2: jetavane viharanto āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ ārabbha kathesi.
dhpak1.10:4.1: Satthā hi pavattitavaradhammacakko rājagahaṃ gantvā veḷuvane viharanto –
dhpak1.10:4.2: “ puttaṃ me ānetvā dassethā ” ti suddhodanamahārājena
dhpak1.10:4.3: pesitānaṃ sahassasahassaparivārānaṃ dasannaṃ dūtānaṃ sabbapacchato gantvā arahattappattena kāḷudāyittherena gamanakālaṃ
dhpak1.10:4.6: vessantarajātakaṃ (jā.2.22.1655 ādayo) kathetvā punadivase piṇḍāya paviṭṭho,“ uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyyā ” ti (dha.
dhpak1.10:4.7: pa.168) gāthāya pitaraṃ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāpetvā,“ dhammañcare
dhpak1.10:5.3: pattaṃ datvā maṅgalaṃ vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamanto nandakumārassa hatthato
dhpak1.10:5.4: pattaṃ na gaṇhi. Sopi tathāgatagāravena “ pattaṃ vo,
dhpak1.10:5.5: bhante, gaṇhathā ” ti vattuṃ nāsakkhi. Evaṃ pana cintesi –
dhpak1.10:5.6: “ sopānasīse pattaṃ gaṇhissatī ” ti. Satthā tasmimpi ṭhāne na gaṇhi.
dhpak1.10:5.7: Itaro “ sopānapādamūle gaṇhissatī ” ti cintesi. Satthā tatthāpi na gaṇhi. Itaro “ rājaṅgaṇe gaṇhissatī ” ti cintesi.
dhpak1.10:5.8: Satthā tatthāpi na gaṇhi. Kumāro nivattitukāmo aruciyā gacchanto
dhpak1.10:5.9: satthugāravena “ pattaṃ gaṇhathā ” ti vattuṃ na sakkoti.
dhpak1.10:5.10: “ Idha gaṇhissati, ettha gaṇhissatī ” ti cintento gacchati.
dhpak1.10:6.1: Tasmiṃ khaṇe aññā itthiyo taṃ disvā janapadakalyāṇiyā ācikkhiṃsu – “ ayye, bhagavā nandakumāraṃ gahetvā gato,
dhpak1.10:6.2: tumhehi taṃ vinā karissatī ” ti. Sā udakabindūhi paggharanteheva aḍḍhullikhitehi kesehi vegena gantvā,“ tuvaṭaṃ kho,
dhpak1.10:6.3: ayyaputta, āgaccheyyāsī ” ti āha. Taṃ tassā vacanaṃ
dhpak1.10:6.4: tassa hadaye tiriyaṃ patitvā viya ṭhitaṃ. Satthāpissa hatthato pattaṃ
dhpak1.10:6.5: aggaṇhitvāva taṃ vihāraṃ netvā,“ pabbajissasi nandā ” tiāha. So buddhagāravena “ na pabbajissāmī ” ti avatvā,“ āma,
dhpak1.10:6.6: pabbajissāmī ” ti āha. Satthā “ tena hi nandaṃ
dhpak1.10:6.7: pabbājethā ” ti āha. Satthā kapilapuraṃ gantvā tatiyadivase nandaṃ pabbājesi.
dhpak1.10:7.1: Sattame divase rāhulamātā kumāraṃ alaṅkaritvā bhagavato santikaṃ pesesi – “ passa, tāta, etaṃ vīsatisahassasamaṇaparivutaṃ
dhpak1.10:7.2: suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ brahmarūpivaṇṇaṃ samaṇaṃ, ayaṃ te pitā, etassa
dhpak1.10:7.3: mahantā nidhikumbhiyo ahesuṃ. Tyāssa nikkhamanato paṭṭhāya na passāma,
dhpak1.10:7.4: gaccha naṃ dāyajjaṃ yācassu – ‘ ahaṃ, tāta, kumāro,
dhpak1.10:7.5: abhisekaṃ patvā cakkavattī bhavissāmi, dhanena me attho, dhanaṃ me dehi.
dhpak1.10:8.1: Kumāro bhagavato santikaṃ gantvāva pitusinehaṃ paṭilabhitvā haṭṭhacitto “
dhpak1.10:8.2: sukhā te, samaṇa, chāyā ” ti vatvā aññampi bahuṃ
dhpak1.10:8.3: attano anurūpaṃ vadanto aṭṭhāsi. Bhagavā katabhattakicco anumodanaṃ katvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
dhpak1.10:9.1: Kumāropi “ dāyajjaṃ me, samaṇa, dehi, dāyajjaṃ me, samaṇa, dehī ” ti bhagavantaṃ anubandhi. Bhagavāpi kumāraṃ na nivattāpesi.
dhpak1.10:9.2: Parijanopi bhagavatā saddhiṃ gacchantaṃ nivattetuṃ nāsakkhi. Iti so
dhpak1.10:9.3: bhagavatā saddhiṃ ārāmameva agamāsi. Tato bhagavā cintesi –
dhpak1.10:9.4: “ yaṃ ayaṃ pitusantakaṃ dhanaṃ icchati, taṃ
dhpak1.10:9.5: vaṭṭānugataṃ savighātaṃ, handassa bodhitale paṭiladdhaṃ sattavidhaṃ ariyadhanaṃ demi,
dhpak1.10:10.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi – “ tena
dhpak1.10:10.2: hi tvaṃ, sāriputta, rāhulakumāraṃ pabbājehī ” ti. Thero kumāraṃ pabbājesi.
dhpak1.10:10.3: Pabbajite ca pana kumāre rañño adhimattaṃ dukkhaṃ
dhpak1.10:10.4: uppajji. Taṃ adhivāsetuṃ asakkonto bhagavato nivedetvā,“ sādhu, bhante,
dhpak1.10:10.5: ayyā, mātāpitūhi ananuññātaṃ puttaṃ na pabbājeyyun ” ti varaṃ yāci.
dhpak1.10:11.1: Bhagavā tassa taṃ varaṃ datvā punekadivasaṃ rājanivesane katapātarāso ekamantaṃ nisinnena raññā,“ bhante,
dhpak1.10:11.2: tumhākaṃ dukkarakārikakāle ekā devatā maṃ upasaṅkamitvā,‘ putto te kālakato ’ ti āha. Ahaṃ tassā vacanaṃ asaddahanto ‘ na
dhpak1.10:11.3: mayhaṃ putto bodhiṃ appatvā kālaṃ karotī ’ ti paṭikkhipin ” ti vutte – “ idāni kiṃ saddahissatha, pubbepi aṭṭhikāni
dhpak1.10:11.4: dassetvā,‘ putto te mato ’ ti vutte na
dhpak1.10:11.5: saddahitvā ” ti imissā atthuppattiyā mahādhammapālajātakaṃ (jā.1.10.92 ādayo) kathesi.
dhpak1.10:13.1: Iti bhagavā pitaraṃ tīsu phalesu patiṭṭhāpetvā
dhpak1.10:13.2: bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto punadeva rājagahaṃ gantvā tato anāthapiṇḍikena
dhpak1.10:13.3: sāvatthiṃ āgamanatthāya gahitapaṭiñño niṭṭhite jetavane vihāre tattha
dhpak1.10:13.4: gantvā vāsaṃ kappesi. Evaṃ satthari jetavane viharante
dhpak1.10:13.5: āyasmā nando ukkaṇṭṭhitvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi
dhpak1.10:13.7: na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.10:14.1: Bhagavā taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ pakkosāpetvā etadavoca
dhpak1.10:14.2: – “ saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, nanda, sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
dhpak1.10:14.3: evaṃ ārocesi – ‘ anabhirato, āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ carāmi,
dhpak1.10:14.4: na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī ”’ ti?
dhpak1.10:14.6: tvaṃ, nanda, anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carasi, na sakkosi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ,
dhpak1.10:14.8: Sākiyānī maṃ, bhante, janapadakalyāṇī gharā nikkhamantassa aḍḍhullikhitehi
dhpak1.10:14.9: kesehi apaloketvā maṃ etadavoca – ‘ tuvaṭaṃ kho, ayyaputta, āgaccheyyāsī ’ ti, so kho ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ anussaramāno
dhpak1.10:14.10: anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carāmi, na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.10:15.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā iddhibalena tāvatiṃsadevalokaṃ ānento antarāmagge ekasmiṃ jhāmakkhette
dhpak1.10:15.2: jhāmakhāṇuke nisinnaṃ chinnakaṇṇanāsanaṅguṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ paluṭṭhamakkaṭiṃ dassetvā tāvatiṃsabhavane sakkassa devarañño upaṭṭhānaṃ
dhpak1.10:16.1: Kakuṭapādānīti rattavaṇṇatāya pārevatapādasadisapādāni. Dassetvā ca panāha
dhpak1.10:16.3: katamā nu kho abhirūpatarā vā dassanīyatarā vā pāsādikatarā vā
dhpak1.10:16.4: sākiyānī vā janapadakalyāṇī, imāni vā pañca accharāsatāni kakuṭapādānī ” ti?
dhpak1.10:17.2: bhante, chinnakaṇṇanāsanaṅguṭṭhā paluṭṭhamakkaṭī, evameva kho, bhante, sākiyānī janapadakalyāṇī,
dhpak1.10:17.3: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhyampi na
dhpak1.10:17.4: upeti, kalampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti.
dhpak1.10:17.5: Atha kho imāneva pañca accharāsatāni abhirūpatarāni ceva dassanīyatarāni ca pāsādikatarāni cā ” ti.
dhpak1.10:18.1: “ Abhirama, nanda, abhirama, nanda, ahaṃ te pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānan ” ti. “ Sace me,
dhpak1.10:18.2: bhante bhagavā, pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya
dhpak1.10:18.3: kakuṭapādānaṃ, abhiramissāmahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati brahmacariye ” ti.
dhpak1.10:19.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ gahetvā tattha antarahito jetavaneyeva pāturahosi. Assosuṃ kho bhikkhū,“ āyasmā kira
dhpak1.10:19.2: nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto accharānaṃ hetu
dhpak1.10:19.3: brahmacariyaṃ carati. Bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ
dhpak1.10:20.1: Atha kho āyasmato nandassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ
dhpak1.10:20.2: nandaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca samudācaranti,“ bhatako
dhpak1.10:20.3: kirāyasmā nando, upakkitako kirāyasmā nando, accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati. Bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ
dhpak1.10:21.1: Atha kho āyasmā nando sahāyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca aṭṭiyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno eko
dhpak1.10:21.2: vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na
dhpak1.10:21.3: cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti,
dhpak1.10:21.4: tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,“ khīṇā jāti,
dhpak1.10:21.5: vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ” ti
dhpak1.10:21.6: abbhaññāsi. Aññataro ca kho panāyasmā nando arahataṃ ahosi.
dhpak1.10:22.1: Athekā devatā rattibhāge sakalaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā ārocesi – “ āyasmā, bhante,
dhpak1.10:22.2: nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto āsavānaṃ khayā
dhpak1.10:22.3: anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā
dhpak1.10:22.4: sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ” ti. Bhagavatopi kho
dhpak1.10:22.5: ñāṇaṃ udapādi “ nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ
dhpak1.10:22.6: paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ” ti.
dhpak1.10:23.1: Sopāyasmā nando tassā rattiyā accayena bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā etadavoca – “ yaṃ me, bhante, bhagavā pāṭibhogo
dhpak1.10:23.2: pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānaṃ, muñcāmahaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ
dhpak1.10:23.3: etasmā paṭissavā ” ti. “ Mayāpi kho te,
dhpak1.10:23.4: nanda, cetasā ceto paricca vidito ‘ nando āsavānaṃ
dhpak1.10:23.5: khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā
dhpak1.10:23.6: sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ’ ti. Devatāpi me etamatthaṃ ārocesi – ‘ āyasmā, bhante, nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ
dhpak1.10:23.7: cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ’ ti. Yadeva kho te, nanda,
dhpak1.10:23.8: anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, athāhaṃ mutto etasmā paṭissavā
dhpak1.10:23.9: ” ti. Atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ
dhpak1.10:24.1: “ Yassa nittiṇṇo paṅko, maddito kāmakaṇṭako; Mohakkhayaṃ anuppatto, sukhadukkhesu na vedhatī sa bhikkhū ” ti.(udā.22);
dhpak1.10:25.1: Athekadivasaṃ bhikkhū taṃ āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ pucchiṃsu – “ āvuso nanda, pubbe
dhpak1.10:25.2: tvaṃ ‘ ukkaṇṭhitomī ’ ti vadesi, idāni te kathan ” ti?
dhpak1.10:25.3: “ Natthi me, āvuso, gihibhāvāya ālayo ” ti. Taṃ sutvā bhikkhū – “ abhūtaṃ āyasmā nando katheti, aññaṃ byākaroti,
dhpak1.10:25.4: atītadivasesu ‘ ukkaṇṭhitomhī ’ ti vatvā idāni ‘ natthi me
dhpak1.10:25.5: gihibhāvāya ālayo ’ ti kathetī ” ti gantvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
dhpak1.10:26.1: Bhagavā “ bhikkhave, atītadivasesu nandassa attabhāvo ducchannagehasadiso ahosi, idāni succhannagehasadiso jāto.
dhpak1.10:26.2: Ayañhi dibbaccharānaṃ diṭṭhakālato paṭṭhāya pabbajitakiccassa matthakaṃ pāpetuṃ vāyamanto taṃ kiccaṃ patto ” ti vatvā imā
dhpak1.10:27.1: 13. “ Yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati; Evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhati.
dhpak1.10:28.1: 13. “ Yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati; Evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhati.
dhpak1.10:29.1: 14. “ Yathā agāraṃ succhannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati; Evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhatī ” ti.
dhpak1.10:30.1: 14. “ Yathā agāraṃ succhannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati; Evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhatī ” ti.
dhpak1.10:31.1: Gāthāpariyosāne bahū sotāpattiphalādīni pāpuṇiṃsu. Mahājanassa desanā sātthikā ahosi.
dhpak1.10:32.1: Atha kho bhikkhū dhammasabhāyaṃ kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpesuṃ,“
dhpak1.10:32.2: āvuso, buddhā nāma acchariyā, janapadakalyāṇiṃ nissāya ukkaṇṭhito
dhpak1.10:32.3: nāmāyasmā nando satthārā devaccharā āmisaṃ katvā vinīto ” ti.
dhpak1.10:33.1: Satthā āgantvā – “ kāya nuttha, bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā
dhpak1.10:33.2: ” ti pucchitvā,“ imāya nāmā ” ti vutte,“ na, bhikkhave,
dhpak1.10:33.3: idāneva, pubbepesa mayā mātugāmena palobhetvā vinītoyevā ” ti vatvā atītaṃ āhari –
dhpak1.10:35.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bārāṇasivāsī kappaṭo nāma vāṇijo ahosi. Tasseko gadrabho kumbhabhāraṃ vahati,
dhpak1.10:35.2: ekadivasena satta yojanāni gacchati. So ekasmiṃ samaye gadrabhabhārakehi saddhiṃ takkasilaṃ gantvā yāva bhaṇḍassa vissajjanaṃ,
dhpak1.10:36.1: Athassa so gadrabho parikhāpiṭṭhe caramāno ekaṃ gadrabhiṃ disvā
dhpak1.10:36.2: upasaṅkami. Sā tena saddhiṃ paṭisanthāraṃ karontī āha –
dhpak1.10:36.3: “ kuto āgatosī ” ti? “ Bārāṇasito ” ti. “ Kena kammenā ” ti? “ Vāṇijjakammenā ” ti. “ Kittakaṃ bhāraṃ vahasī ” ti?
dhpak1.10:36.4: “ Kumbhabhāran ” ti? “ Ettakaṃ bhāraṃ vahanto kati yojanāni gacchasī
dhpak1.10:36.5: ” ti? “ Satta yojanānī ” ti. “ Gatagataṭṭhāne te kāci
dhpak1.10:36.6: pādaparikammapiṭṭhiparikammakarā atthī ” ti? “ Natthī ” ti. “ Evaṃ sante mahādukkhaṃ nāma anubhosī ” ti?
dhpak1.10:37.1: “ Kiñcāpi hi tiracchānagatānaṃ pādaparikammādikārakā nāma natthi, kāmasaṃyojanaghaṭṭanatthāya pana evarūpaṃ kathaṃ kathesi ”?
dhpak1.10:38.1: So tassā kathāya ukkaṇṭhi. Kappaṭopi bhaṇḍaṃ vissajjetvā tassa santikaṃ
dhpak1.10:38.2: āgantvā – “ ehi, tāta, gamissāmā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.10:38.3: “ Gacchatha tumhe, nāhaṃ gamissāmī ” ti. Atha naṃ punappunaṃ
dhpak1.10:38.4: yācitvā,“ anicchantaṃ paribhāsetvā naṃ nessāmī ” ti cintetvā gāthamāha –
dhpak1.10:39.1: “ Patodaṃ te karissāmi, sāḷasaṅgulikaṇṭakaṃ; Sañchindissāmi te kāyaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi gadrabhā ” ti.
dhpak1.10:40.1: Taṃ sutvā gadrabho “ evaṃ sante ahampi te kattabbaṃ jānissāmī ” ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.10:41.1: “ Patodaṃ me karissasi, soḷasaṅgulikaṇṭakaṃ; Purato patiṭṭhahitvāna, uddharitvāna
dhpak1.10:41.2: pacchato; Dantaṃ te pātayissāmi, evaṃ jānāhi kappaṭā ” ti.
dhpak1.10:42.1: Taṃ sutvā vāṇijo – “ kena nu kho kāraṇena esa evaṃ
dhpak1.10:42.2: vadatī ” ti cintetvā, ito cito ca olokento taṃ gadrabhiṃ disvā,“ imāyesa
dhpak1.10:42.3: evaṃ sikkhāpito bhavissati,‘ evarūpiṃ nāma te gadrabhiṃ ānessāmī ’
dhpak1.10:42.4: ti mātugāmena naṃ palobhetvā nessāmī ” ti imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.10:43.1: “ Catuppadiṃ saṅkhamukhiṃ, nāriṃ sabbaṅgasobhiniṃ; Bhariyaṃ te ānayissāmi, evaṃ jānāhi gadrabhā ” ti.
dhpak1.10:44.1: Taṃ sutvā tuṭṭhacitto gadrabho imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.10:45.3: jānāhi kappaṭa; Kappaṭa bhiyyo gamissāmi, yojanāni catuddasā ” ti.
dhpak1.10:46.1: Atha naṃ kappaṭo,“ tena hi ehī ” ti gahetvā sakaṭṭhānaṃ agamāsi.
dhpak1.10:47.1: So katipāhaccayena naṃ āha – “ nanu maṃ tumhe ‘ bhariyaṃ te ānayissāmī ’ ti avocutthā ” ti? “ Āma, vuttaṃ,
dhpak1.10:47.2: nāhaṃ attano kathaṃ bhindissāmi, bhariyaṃ te ānessāmi,
dhpak1.10:47.3: vetanaṃ pana tuyhaṃ ekakasseva dassāmi, tuyhaṃ vetanaṃ dutiyassa
dhpak1.10:47.4: pahotu vā mā vā, tvameva jāneyyāsi. Ubhinnaṃ pana
dhpak1.10:47.5: vo saṃvāsamanvāya puttā vijāyissanti, tehipi bahūhi saddhiṃ tuyhaṃ taṃ
dhpak1.10:47.6: pahotu vā mā vā, tvameva jāneyyāsī ” ti. Gadrabho tasmiṃ kathenteyeva anapekkho ahosi.
dhpak1.10:48.1: Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā,“ tadā, bhikkhave,
dhpak1.10:48.2: gadrabhī janapadakalyāṇī ahosi, gadrabho nando, vāṇijo ahameva.
dhpak1.10:48.3: Evaṃ pubbepesa mayā mātugāmena palobhetvā vinīto ” ti jātakaṃ niṭṭhāpesīti.
